approved_spec_requirements.architecture: Single FastAPI deployment backed by PostgreSQL, modular monolith with 5 explicit module boundaries: commercial, catalog, organization, scheduling, audit. Application use cases per module; infrastructure adapters for persistence.
approved_spec_requirements.scope_in: Lead registration + acquisition source (promotion/referral/direct); service need; active services with authoritative durations; locations with IANA time zones; practitioners with service/location capabilities; recurring availability (AvailabilityRule, evaluated in location time zone) and exceptional blocks (ScheduleBlock); eligible-slot queries; confirm/cancel/reschedule appointments; audit of creation, cancellation, rescheduling.
approved_spec_requirements.scope_out: Clinical records/visit outcomes; charges/payments/debts/NubeFact; inventory/product consumption; WhatsApp/Google Calendar/voice/STT adapters; autonomous agents/LLM decisions in deterministic rules; MediStock table-for-table migration; lead deduplication.
approved_spec_requirements.entities: Lead (name, >=1 contact channel phone/email, acquisition source, service need, commercial status); Service (stable id, name, authoritative duration, active); Location (stable id, name, active, IANA tz); Practitioner (stable id, display name, active); PractitionerCapability (practitioner+service+location, only active eligible); AvailabilityRule (recurring interval, location tz); ScheduleBlock (exceptional closed interval); Appointment (lead/service/practitioner/location refs, start/end instants, state confirmed|cancelled; completed/no_show reserved for later vertical).
approved_spec_requirements.core_flow: Register/select lead; associate active service need; query slots for service+location+date range; filter practitioners (active, active capability, service, location); compute candidate starts on 15-minute grid in location tz using catalog duration, interval must fit wholly within availability and intersect neither blocks nor confirmed appointments; select slot; in ONE transaction reload authoritative duration, revalidate capability/availability, reject overlaps, create confirmed appointment; return stable identifiers + calculated start/end.
approved_spec_requirements.concurrency: Database provides final concurrency guarantee: partial GiST exclusion constraint equivalent to EXCLUDE USING gist (practitioner_id WITH =, tstzrange(start_utc, end_utc, '[)') WITH &&) WHERE (state = 'confirmed'); extension enabled by migration; SQLSTATE 23P01 maps to stable appointment-conflict 409; cancelled appointments do not block interval reuse; no race-prone read-before-write as correctness basis.
approved_spec_requirements.api: Register/read leads; admin surfaces for services/locations/practitioners/capabilities; availability + blocks definition; slot queries; confirm/cancel/reschedule. Error contract: 422 malformed input, 404 nonexistent reference, 409 inactive/missing capability/blocked/conflict; responses carry stable machine-readable error code + safe human detail. OpenAPI must describe surfaces and error schemas.
approved_spec_requirements.audit: Append-only records for appointment creation, cancellation, rescheduling: actor id + type, action, entity id + type, UTC timestamp, relevant before/after state, correlation id when supplied. Rescheduling writes old+new intervals in before/after payload, same transaction, no externally visible intermediate state.
approved_spec_requirements.deterministic_rules: All of service/location/practitioner/capability active; capability matches service+location; appointment fits wholly inside an availability interval; does not intersect schedule block; no overlapping active appointments per practitioner; duration from catalog (client cannot override); concurrency-safe booking/rescheduling; only confirmed appointments consume availability; LLM cannot override conflict responses.
approved_spec_requirements.testing: Tests before implementation: valid lead registration; invalid acquisition source rejection; practitioner filtering by capability+location; inactive entity exclusion; slot calculation from availability+authoritative duration; exclusion of blocks and confirmed appointments; ignoring client duration override; confirming valid appointment; racing two confirmations with exactly one persisted; cancel releases slot; atomic reschedule with audit trail; stable 404/409/422 contracts. Unit tests for interval/transition rules; PostgreSQL integration tests for overlap/transactions/concurrency; FastAPI integration tests for request/response.
approved_spec_requirements.definition_of_done: Postgres migrations define minimum model + overlap guarantee; FastAPI exposes approved behavior; unit + Postgres integration tests pass; OpenAPI describes public surfaces and error schemas; audit records for all required transitions; no external adapter/LLM on booking decision path; works for at least two locations and two practitioners with different capabilities; no MediStock application code modified.
approved_spec_requirements.deferred: Commercial status progression; min booking lead time / max horizon; capability varying by date vs active state only; cancellation policy and who may cancel/reschedule; auth/role model.
